'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Cole Lepine LS Yavin 4 Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Cole Lepine]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Buff Wookies. Sheet lists 57 Reserve Deck cards after strikes (#14, #36–37 omitted; Control & Tunnel Vision from Additional Cards).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
